changes: Notifications now appear even when the Ask Omi floating bar is disabled: the card pops up briefly and the bar hides itself again. Only the Notifications toggle controls whether notifications are shown.
Opening a task from the dashboard that was already cancelled or deleted now says it is no longer available, instead of switching to Tasks and selecting nothing

Proactive context now connects related work across apps — reading a PR, chatting about it, and drafting an email on the same project share one workstream's context — and reacts after 2 seconds on a page instead of 8
